{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|And so, I have aided his Confederate stooges in contriving the corrosive stone mite and blue virus plagues, provided his cyborg supreme commander with samples of my mutagenic 3L41UH7 serum, and granted Count Dooku access to my Wayland facility for his dashta tissues and shadow army.|[[Zeta Magnus]]|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
The '''3L41UH7 serum''' was a mutagenic fluid created by [[Zeta Magnus]], an [[Accelerated Transgenic Heuristic Abhorer]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Magnus provided [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with samples of that serum.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Incidentally, the name for that serum is a THX 1138 gag. I love the film, but since those types of jokes have been done to death in Star Wars, I used the designation of THX's ill-fated girlfriend LUH 3417 instead.|[[Abel G. Peña]]|<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/52366299|board=Literature|thread=Abel G. Peña's "Skyewalkers" and "Lone Wolf"|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2015-05-05|time=9:45 pm|archivedate=20230517212154}}</ref>}}
''SkyeWalkers'' author [[Abel G. Peña]] intended this serum to be the one seen in ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' used to mutate the [[Nelvaanian/Legends|natives]] of [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]]. Influenced by the many homages in ''Star Wars'' materials to [[George Lucas]]'s earlier film, [[1138 (disambiguation)|THX-1138]], Peña named the substance after LUH-3417, the love interest of the title character of the film.<ref name="JCF" />
